sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Special Equipment is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Greetings, mercenary. My contacts are in need of a large supply of military equipment. You could definitely help us in this matter. Will you find the required items for us? I will make a list of the needed equipment."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must reach Loyalty Level 4 with Peacekeeper to obtain this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find 5 VPX Flash Storage Modules in raid
- Find 5 UHF RFID Readers in raid
- Find 5 Virtex programmable processors in raid
- Find 5 Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitters in raid
- Find 4 Military flash drives in raid
- Hand over 5 VPX Flash Storage Modules to Peacekeeper
- Hand over 5 UHF RFID Readers to Peacekeeper
- Hand over 5 Virtex programmable processors to Peacekeeper
- Hand over 5 Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitters to Peacekeeper
- Hand over 4 Military flash drives to Peacekeeper

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +65,000 EXP
- +4 Pistols skill levels
- +4 Revolvers skill levels
- Peacekeeper Rep +1.5
- 2,750 Dollars
  - 2,888 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 3,163 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
- Unlocks barter for T H I C C item case at Peacekeeper LL4
- Unlocks craft for 5.56x45mm M855A1 at Workbench level 3
"Good, good. We highly appreciate all you have done for us, mercenary. See you later."
